pages.name: conformance
pages.title: sf-chart-parts against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §12, gate 20)
pages.format: the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

body: <sf-chart-parts id="c" label="Диск" category="kind" value="size" max="100" value-format="integer"></sf-chart-parts>
<sf-chart-parts id="s" label="Группы" category="group" value="n" max-parts="3" table="hidden"></sf-chart-parts>

checks.title: a figure named by its label; the head says the used share of the capacity; the bar is one group described by the parts, the largest first, and the free remainder
checks.covers: accessibility (role figure, name label), settings.items, settings.max, settings.total, settings.summary

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"system": "Система", "apps": "Приложения", "docs": "Документы", "photos": "Фото"}; c.items = [{"kind": "system", "size": 22}, {"kind": "apps", "size": 13}, {"kind": "docs", "size": 7}, {"kind": "photos", "size": 3}]; document.querySelector('#s').items = [{"group": "a", "n": 50}, {"group": "b", "n": 30}, {"group": "c", "n": 10}, {"group": "d", "n": 6}, {"group": "e", "n": 4}, {"group": "f", "n": null}]; return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('#c figure'); const t = document.querySelector('#c [role=group]'); const d = document.getElementById(t.getAttribute('aria-describedby')).textContent.replace(/\u00a0/gu, ' '); const head = document.querySelector('#c .sf-chart-parts-whole').textContent.trim().replace(/\u00a0/gu, ' '); return f && document.getElementById(f.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).textContent.trim() === 'Диск' && t.getAttribute('aria-roledescription') === 'полоса частей' && /^45 из 100 \(45 ?%\)$/u.test(head) && /^Занято 45 из 100 \(45 ?%\)\. Система: 22 \(22 ?%\)\./u.test(d) && /Свободно: 55 \(55 ?%\)\.$/u.test(d) && document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-parts-part').length === 5 && document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-parts-item').length === 5; })()

checks.title: the arrows walk the parts and the free remainder, each move said; Enter chooses a part, never the remainder
checks.covers: keyboard.host (ArrowRight, Home, End, Enter, Escape), events.select

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"system": "Система", "apps": "Приложения", "docs": "Документы", "photos": "Фото"}; c.items = [{"kind": "system", "size": 22}, {"kind": "apps", "size": 13}, {"kind": "docs", "size": 7}, {"kind": "photos", "size": 3}]; document.querySelector('#s').items = [{"group": "a", "n": 50}, {"group": "b", "n": 30}, {"group": "c", "n": 10}, {"group": "d", "n": 6}, {"group": "e", "n": 4}, {"group": "f", "n": null}]; return true; })()

(() => { window.__chosen = null; document.querySelector('#c').addEventListener('sf-chart-parts-select', (event) => { window.__chosen = event.detail; }); document.querySelector('#c [role=group]').focus(); return true; })()

checks.title: without a capacity the bar is the sum and has no remainder; past max-parts the smallest fold into «Другое»; the table keeps every row

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"system": "Система", "apps": "Приложения", "docs": "Документы", "photos": "Фото"}; c.items = [{"kind": "system", "size": 22}, {"kind": "apps", "size": 13}, {"kind": "docs", "size": 7}, {"kind": "photos", "size": 3}]; document.querySelector('#s').items = [{"group": "a", "n": 50}, {"group": "b", "n": 30}, {"group": "c", "n": 10}, {"group": "d", "n": 6}, {"group": "e", "n": 4}, {"group": "f", "n": null}]; return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('#s .sf-chart-parts-item-name')].map((one) => one.textContent.trim()); return names.length === 3 && names[2] === 'Другое' && /^всего 100$/u.test(document.querySelector('#s .sf-chart-parts-whole').textContent.trim()) && !document.querySelector('#s .sf-chart-parts-series--free') && document.querySelectorAll('#s table tbody tr').length === 6; })()

checks.title: parts past the capacity fill the bar and the summary says by how much

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"system": "Система", "apps": "Приложения", "docs": "Документы", "photos": "Фото"}; c.items = [{"kind": "system", "size": 22}, {"kind": "apps", "size": 13}, {"kind": "docs", "size": 7}, {"kind": "photos", "size": 3}]; document.querySelector('#s').items = [{"group": "a", "n": 50}, {"group": "b", "n": 30}, {"group": "c", "n": 10}, {"group": "d", "n": 6}, {"group": "e", "n": 4}, {"group": "f", "n": null}]; return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#c [role=group]'); const d = document.getElementById(t.getAttribute('aria-describedby')).textContent.replace(/\u00a0/gu, ' '); return /^Занято 45 из 40: больше на 5\./u.test(d) && !document.querySelector('#c .sf-chart-parts-series--free.sf-chart-parts-part'); })()

checks.title: the error state offers a retry that sends refresh

steps.script: (() => { const button = document.querySelector('#e sf-empty-state button'); if (button) button.click(); return true; })()
